quote: It kept 28-58% of correctly placed in-SD reads at ≤ 0.1% error, a level no reported-MAPQ threshold reaches.
issue: 'It' is the chromosome-held-out recalibrator (GBM + isotonic) of the previous sentence, but 28-58% is the raw GBM score's ranking with the 0.1% threshold chosen on held-out labels. The calibrated GBM+iso keeps 0% for all six long-read runs (35-46% for Illumina); with label-free thresholds at a 0.1% target the recalibrator realised 0.06-0.40% in-SD error.
evidence: L5_tables.md Table 2 col 'Correct kept at ≤0.1% error: reported / GBM / GBM+iso' (GBM 28-58%; GBM+iso 0% long reads, 35-46% Illumina); L5_mapq_calibration.md: 'That last threshold is chosen on held-out labels, so it measures ranking'; Table 3 realised error at 0.1% target GBM+iso 0.06-0.40%.
suggested_fix: Ranking by the model's boosted score (threshold set on held-out labels) kept 28-58% of correctly placed in-SD reads at ≤ 0.1% error, a level no reported-MAPQ threshold reaches; label-free, the calibrated model realised 0.06-0.40% error at a 0.1% target.

suggested_fix: Inside SDs, MAPQ 60 was wrong for 1.23-2.77% of reads on GRCh38 and 0.49-1.42% on CHM13 (long reads: ≥50%-lifted truth; 0.12-0.33% under a strict ≥90%-colinear truth), against a nominal 10^−6^.
